purpose: Read-only audit of remaining bottlenecks after the accepted three streaming optimizations
hypotheses: Synchronous registration dominates conventional media after the prior pipeline gains
Text scaling is dominated by SQLite and repeated per-note conversion
Long-field peak memory is caused by overlapping owned field representations
Remaining media pipeline time includes material channel/copy/allocator overhead
output_gate: Exact package bytes equal across variants and to the previously independently verified accepted reference
limitations: Diagnostic probes perturb timings; absolute phase sums may overlap and medians need not add up.
Native power source is checked before and after every attempt.
No performance claims for custom note types, persistent artifacts, or real high-resolution image distributions.
